summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, lore-based destinations, a social mall and solo tutorial spaces. `templates/player.js` composes shared behaviors; `scripts/player.js` owns player progression and combat, while place simulations and shared libraries build/tick environments, NPCs and crossings. NPC talk and barks now use authored dialogue data and deterministic voice identities rather than model-generated replies; cat looks and live facial animation remain shared appearance systems.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0/Lobby maze; sim lays ecology, generated moments, safe rooms and routes to exits.
places/bonus (3D) - vaporwave mall with authored shops, escalators and simulated staff/shoppers; shared hub destination.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial route.
places/level01 (3D) - Zenith Station: station, breach, doors, bots, hazards and recorder quest.

places/level1, level2, level21, level3, gamma (3D) - Habitable Zone/M.E.G. camp, Pipe Dreams, Locked, Electrical Station and Base Gamma; Level 3 sim generates paired hatches and industrial details; Level 1 cells include job-styled B.N.T.G. residents.

places/level4, level5, level6, level7 (3D) - Abandoned Office, Terror Hotel, drowned house and sea/Fort Surrender; Level 5 cells and level5-people.yml define hotel, Housekeeping and Originals residents, including Brother Wat's pilgrim outfit.
places/level10, level11, level12 (3D) - lake, generated city/canal and renovation office; Level 11 connects to player home11.
places/level26, level27, level184, level61, spamton, testlab and other special places (3D) - SS Fun, Bunker Springs, forts, Snackrooms, arena and Test Range.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, camera/player setup, ordered behaviors and input mappings.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local place config, authored placements and generated/ticked simulation.
scripts/main-menu.js + main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts - title, creation, arrival and tutorial routing.
scripts/player.js + scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - player state/actions, aiming camera and third-person toggle.

places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/level0-moments.js - Level 0 maze simulation and seeded environmental moments; places/level1/sim.js + scripts/lib/level1.js - seeded layout, camp, doors and threshold dressing.
scripts/talk.js + scripts/talk-ui.js, entered by scripts/interact.js - authored NPC conversation choices, replies, gestures and talk card.
scripts/lib/quests.js + quest-marker.js + quest-mark.js + quest-route.js - quest state, objective resolution and local/remote markers.
places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + places/testlab/sim.js - authored mall/escalator and generated Test Range facilities.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js - solo room IDs, Bonus Room/home destinations and LEVEL_NAMES used by hub UI.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/weapons.js/scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml - common loot, containers, item definitions, rarity and weapon variants.
scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js + scripts/lib/level3-hatch.js - parametric door geometry/motion and deterministic Level 3 paired wall-hatch layout.
scripts/lib/thresholds.js + scripts/threshold-geo.js - versioned crossing clues shared by participating place simulations.
scripts/lib/quest-route.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - crossing graph and objective resolver for tracked quests.
scripts/lib/data/preload.yml + scripts/lib/preload-next.js - door-to-destination/model manifest used by player proximity preloading.
scripts/lib/sign-style.js + scripts/sign-geo.js + scripts/lib/data/signs.yml - per-place/id visual styles and generated sign boards; participating place sims call restyleSigns.

scripts/lib/dialogue.js + scripts/lib/data/dlg-*.yml - named NPC dialogue and faction/role archetypes reused by talk, social barks and combat; scripts/lib/data/npc-voices.yml + scripts/lib/voices.js assign stable NPC voice keys.
notableExports: scripts/lib/thresholds.js - dressThresholds; scripts/threshold-geo.js - threshold geometry/material builders.

scripts/lib/quest-route.js - nextQuestExit; scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - questMark; scripts/lib/quests.js - MAX_TRACK, TINT, PLACE_NAMES, qid, setQuest, endQuest, tracked, toggleTrack; places/level1 and level5 sims - cadence/agentSpec/tick and cadence/lay/breakables/tick.

scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf, rollWeapon, gateItems, rollLock, rollCash, rollItem, spawnCrate and Level 2 helpers; scripts/lib/weapons.js - baseOf, variantOf, rollVariant, rarityIdx, rarityCap, default.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack, onInput, hitTarget, fish callbacks, HOLO/holoEnd and throwable callbacks.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js - STYLE_V (sw190), setStyle, HUMAN, appearance builders and restyle queue/steps; scripts/lib/clothes.js - NL_V (nl7), refitLook; scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js - CAT_BODY/CAT_OLD/CAT_BODY2, faceLife, liveFace and related cat builders.
scripts/lib/dialogue.js - DLG, archOf, entryOf, rootChoices, childChoices, nodeOf, greetingOf, lineOf, barkOf, gestOf, BYE_CHOICE; scripts/lib/voices.js - voiceKey, hasVoice, throatOf, vo.
scripts/lib/body3.js - heldRot, famOf, play, tick3, swing3, fire3, handle3, react3, stagger3, aimPose, aimMode, longHands, stance; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - VM_FOV, poseViewmodel.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment, needs, combat, access, appearance, saved position and carried tapes; lib/forgive.js records NPC grudges in player.state.grudges.
scripts/lib/quests.js - player.state.quests, qtrack and qdone; quest handlers own quest-specific state; dina-quest.js owns dinaQ, dinaDiary, dcut and seeds the-way-back.
scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js - kick cooldowns and carry/held target session; held objects own heldBy/down/stagger state and player.state.carryMul is reset when the carry ends.

scripts/lib/loose.js + breakables.js - loose prop state and wrecks; permanently smashed root IDs live in place.state.gone; breakable wall hp and broken-cell/whole-wall timestamps live in place.state.wallHp/broken.
scripts/lib/knock.js + stats.js - foe weight/attributes and down/stagger outcomes; enemy managers own AI and sneakTarget.
Place sims - local generated scene and migration markers, including Level 1 back-door rebuild, Level 3 hatchV/lineV and Level 4 office/island conversions.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js - NPC model/body/attachment rebuilds and persisted state.wear restyle marker nl; clothes.js generates stable seeded role/faction appearance, while explicit wear fields remain authoritative.

scripts/talk.js owns player.state.talks and transient talk choices/session; NPC state owns rapport, memory, current spoken line and mood. scripts/lib/prop-interactions.js + scripts/prop-part.js own prop pose/goals; scripts/critter.js/cat-wardrobe liveFace derive transient facial animation from NPC speech and state.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb, interact, grab/kick, build, inventory, combat, social, hub, camera and quest behaviors.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera; camera writes aimPt/aimPitch → player.js ballistics.
scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js solo room selection; toHub/toSolo cross to hub/home and maintain roomHop/save-place state.
Fresh visit → main-menu.js; START routes to intake or Bonus, wardrobe close to intro/tutorial0; menuOpen drives menu UI and solo pause scales place time; hub UI routes Bonus/home destinations.
Bonus sim lays NPCs/effects and mall handlers consume shop/food state; escalator steps use esc-step.js.
interact.js loot search → loot.gateItems → items/weapons roll; rarity caps are 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite; focus → player.state.focus → loot/talk/shop UI.
interact open/closeLoot → prop-interactions.containerPose → child part state.goal → prop-part.js animation; toggleLamp changes light-part goals.
Player craft action/UI → craft.js + craft.yml; breakables/build pieces define station; craft UI filters station recipes while hand menu lists all.
Tracked quest → quest-marker.js → questMark/nextQuestExit gated crossing graph → local objective or remote exit marker and journal.
Place sims → restyleSigns and dressThresholds; doorway handlers call carryAcross before local ctx.cross and record xferTo, which player.js consumes for arrival markers.

scripts/player.js update → preloadTick reads nearby door IDs and preload.yml → preload event for destination models; forgiveTick reads NPC anger/player.grudges and clears grudge after an in-game hour.

interact.js opens talk.js → dialogue.js selects authored greeting/choice tree from dlg-*.yml; talk.js validates the offered choice, rolls authored checks and routes quest choices to quest handlers → player history/NPC rapport and line/mood; voices.js voiceKey selects npc-voices.yml audio, while barkOf supplies talk/social and meg-agent combat lines.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus scenes + bonus data/sim + mall shopper/salon scripts - authored mall, NPCs and counter behavior; escalator steps share motor behavior with placement-specific direction/phase.
scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction scripts - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild flow.

scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js and prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametrically generated doors/storage parts with eased motion and legacy prop migration.
scripts/lib/thresholds.js + threshold-geo.js + participating place sims, alongside sign-style.js/sign-geo.js - shared threshold dressing and per-place/per-ID sign-board styles across place sims.
places/level01/sim.js + Zenith geometry, breach, hatch, bot and hazard scripts - Zenith Station environment and interactive systems.

places/level3/sim.js + level3-details-geo.js + lib/level3-hatch.js + l3-hatch*.js + scripts/l3-line.js - tiled Electrical Station detail, paired steel hatches and animated belt boxes varied by line layout/state.

places/level4 scenes/sim + l4-office, l4-office-geo, l4-home and resident data; scripts/lib/clothes.js + npc-looks.yml + critter-model.js + cat-wardrobe.yml + mat-catskin.js - resident fixtures and deterministic NPC/player body, clothing and face variation.

scripts/lib/dialogue.js + dlg-*.yml + npc-voices.yml + voices.js - authored named-person and faction/role dialogue, bark kinds and stable per-NPC voice identity reused across levels and talk/combat/social handlers.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists, while Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is the documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js, scripts/debug-pad.js, scripts/lib/debug-layout.js - debug-room pads/layout after places/debug removal; no current references found.
scripts/l3-line.js is attached by places/level3/sim.js; the older uploaded l3-assembly-line-2 model remains unreferenced by active line placements.
migrationNotes: Threshold dressing version is V=7 in scripts/lib/thresholds.js; upgrades clean/rebuild thr-tagged objects and remain delayed/incremental until place colliders stand. Preserve thrSeen/thrTry/thrDone/thrV protocol.

Door transfers: carryAcross records xferTo only for local place links with a # marker and crosses carryId/nearby heldBy objects, rejecting room/world and Bonus destinations; Level 1 BACK uses backV destroy-and-respawn migration.

scripts/lib/sign-style.js only restyles eligible shallow box signs with UI, leaves emissive/light signs alone, and is throttled/idempotent; preserve source IDs, dimensions, text, colour and placement while signs.yml selects style.

Level 3 hatchV=3 rebuild destroys old l3-hatch-* objects; hatchAt deterministically shares each wall's door across its two faces. Level 3 lineV=2 replaces legacy line-model instances with three Tripo stations and animated belt boxes.

Cat appearance migration is critter-model STYLE_V=sw190 plus clothes NL_V=nl7: only non-player new-cat NPCs with stale/missing nl are job/faction refit; explicit wear choices survive. Keep cat-wardrobe dimensions in metres, y-up, front +z; cat face state remains derived, not saved.

Talk lines and choice text are authored in dlg-*.yml; talk.js accepts only the currently offered exact choice and quest choices must keep the phrase their quest handler matches. NPC speech line/mood also drive cat mouth/expression; voiceKey prefers the individual npc-voices.yml mapping before carried or seeded fallback keys.
